description: NBU official international (reserve) assets for a given month, broken down by component. Each record: {dt (YYYYMMDD), txt (Ukrainian name), txten (English name), id_api, value, freq}. `date` selects the reference month; omit for the latest available month.

date.description: Reference day inside the month, YYYYMMDD, e.g. "20240101". Omit for latest.

name: nbu_international_reserves
